signals.title: Holders ~30% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.7: price is 30% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.502). Yet 56% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 0.98→0.7 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -85% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: NUPL -0.43 — capitulation
signals.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.43 (from MVRV 0.7) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
signals.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
signals.note: A position read, not a signal.
